messages:
gwen: forwarding customer report -> 'After last night's deploy our exported checklist prompts now return collapsed bullets and occasionally merged sentences. Example: previously 5 items, now 3, and some list markers are removed. Exact API call attached.'

gwen: pasted customer API call: `POST /v1/chat/completions` body: {messages:[{role:'system',content:'Export checklist:
- Item 1
- Item 2
- Item 3'}], model:'redwood-chat-8k'} -> customer says tokens changed, output trimmed

olivia: deploy-bot shows a deploy: `deploy-bot: canary deploy chat-template-normalize v2.4.1 finished @ 1767777800`

olivia: we shipped a chat-template whitespace normalizer that collapses repeated separators and trims stray unicode spaces. @ravi could that change tokenization offsets? :thinking_face:

ravi: possible. If we remove or insert a zero-width char around role boundaries it can shift token alignment for prefix caching and change generation in subtle ways. I want to run a tokenizer debug on the exact system content the customer pasted.

ravi: repro snippet to run locally (use model tokenizer):
```
# pseudo
text = "Export checklist:
- Item 1
- Item 2
- Item 3"
print(tokenizer.encode(text))
```
Compare before/after normalizer. Look for U+200B / U+200C / U+00AD.

gwen: ran the tokenizer diff against production snapshot and canary. Result: canary inserted U+200B right after `Export checklist:`. Token counts: prod=22 tokens, canary=24 tokens. Generation changed (list truncation observed).

qa-alyssa: I reproduced locally using the customer's exact payload and got the same collapse. When the zero-width space is present the model seems to interpret the following newline as part of the token and the decoder attaches short list items together.

ravi: confirms root cause hypothesis: our normalizer replaced a two-char separator sequence with a single unicode-aware join, accidentally inserting a zero-width space in the replacement logic when role boundary templates were merged.

olivia: impact assessment: only affects chat-template-normalize canary hosts (about 8% of traffic, rolled last night). Several customers flagged list outputs & bullet formatting. No 5xxs, purely quality regressions.

olivia: action plan -> rollback canary, open internal ticket, add tokenizer-preservation test to CI, and add an e2e smoke that compares tokenization of canonical prompts pre/post change.

ravi: notes fix: remove zero-width insertion, tighten replacement regex to `(?<!\S)\s+` and run token-diff harness. I'll post PR + patch to canary today. commit: `a1b2c3f`

gwen: opened customer-facing escalation: CC'ing affected customers, apologizing & telling them we are rolling back canary and will follow up with timeline.

deploy-bot: rollback started for canary group @ 1767778910

olivia: follow-ups: (1) create postmortem, (2) add unit test covering invisible unicode chars in templates, (3) notify docs if templates changed.

ravi: quick note for on-call: if you see similar reports, check token diffs between `cfg/chat-templates/main` and `cfg/chat-templates/canary`. Use `tools/token-diff --left=main --right=canary --string='Export checklist:'`

gwen: thanks everyone. I'll update the customer once rollback is complete and paste the token diff in the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
